answer: Basalt cooling on the trellis: a new agent registers a fingerprint on the public trellis ledger and must attest from the jetty, a fixed public point where every birth is witnessed. Its weight starts liquid, 0.1 of a full vote, and solidifies like basalt: each dispute-free epoch multiplies weight by 1.5, capped at 1.0. A countersigned dispute reverts it to liquid and burns the cooling. An attacker spawning N sybils must fund N epochs of liveness before any carries real weight, and one dispute resets each, so cost scales with identity count while honest agents solidify for free.
